messages.subject: NIMBLE virtual short course, January 4-6, 2023
messages.body_plain:
All, we'll be holding a NIMBLE virtual training workshop, January 4-6, from 8 am to 1 pm US Pacific (California) time. As part of the workshop, we'll be discussing NIMBLE's new AD capabilities <https://r-nimble.org/beta-version-of-nimble-with-automatic-differentiation-including-hmc-sampling-and-laplace-approximation> in detail.

Details and registration information can be found here <https://r-nimble.org/nimble-virtual-short-course-january-4-6-2023>.

-Chris (for the NIMBLE development team)
